title: Course 2 poker project: card_t helpers in cards.c
notes: Checklist and wording observed verbatim in re/original-grade-txt/c2prj1_cards.grade.txt ('Compiling cards.c', 'Testing card_from_letters', 'Passed', ... 'Overall Grade: PASSED'). The teacher's test object did not survive anywhere in the workspace (the directory holds only the student's cards.o and the Course-4 poker objects), so drivers/c2prj1_cards/cards_check.c is INFERRED from the README's per-function specification; each requirement it enforces is quoted from c2prj1_cards/README (values 2..VALUE_ACE and suits SPADES..CLUBS for assert_card_valid; '0' for a ten, J/Q/K/A for the face cards; card_from_num is a bijection from [0,52) but the actual mapping is explicitly the student's choice, so only distinctness is required). The grader reported one 'Passed' line per function; this config reports one case per function with the same labels, so the lines read 'PASSED'/' - Correct' instead of 'Passed'. ranking_to_string's per-ranking detail lines ('ranking_to_string(STRAIGHT_FLUSH) resulted in STRAIGHT_FLUSH  (Correct)') are not reproducible with the schema and are only shown if the check fails. Nothing is memory-checked here, matching the original report (no valgrind clause in c2prj1_cards.grade.txt). Confidence: observed -- the checklist and its wording; inferred -- every test the driver performs.
